The term has also become popular amongst various Christian communities, influencing various forms of Christian literature and art, in which it may represent both holy infants or saintly young girls.

It may also represent a divine spiritual guide for young children, acting as a sign of God’s protection and care. In church hymns and prayers, "Babby" may becalled upon as a symbol of the childlike faith and trust needed to deepen one's spiritual connection to God. Additionally, "Babby" can also be used interchangeably with the term "Mother Mary," evoking the idea of a loving and nurturing protectress.
